description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'BaseHyphenatedIdentifierValidator' that implements logic for validating and generating identifiers with a hyphen before a check digit. It includes methods for checking identifier validity, computing check digits, and ensuring identifier characters are allowed. This class is part of the OpenMRS project, specifically within the 'org.openmrs.patient.impl' package.

classes.name: BaseHyphenatedIdentifierValidator
classes.description: An abstract class providing common validation logic for hyphenated identifiers with a check digit, used within the OpenMRS patient management system.

methods.name: getCheckDigit
methods.description: Abstract method to compute the check digit for a given undecorated identifier.

methods.name: getAllowedCharacters
methods.description: Abstract method to return the allowed characters for the identifier.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Abstract method to return the name of the validator.

methods.name: getValidIdentifier
methods.description: Generates a valid identifier by appending a check digit character based on the undecorated identifier.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if a given identifier is valid, with detailed rules and check digit verification.

methods.name: checkAllowedIdentifier
methods.description: Ensures the identifier does not contain null, empty, whitespace, or invalid characters.

methods.name: convertCheckDigitToChar
methods.description: Converts a numerical check digit (0-9) to its corresponding character (A-J).
